scripts.check:wiring:display: npm run check:fast && tsci check netlist seven-segment-display.circuit.tsx && tsci check schematic-placement seven-segment-display.circuit.tsx
scripts.check:wiring:controller: npm run check:fast && tsci check netlist controller.circuit.tsx && tsci check schematic-placement controller.circuit.tsx
scripts.check:full:display: npm run check:wiring:display && tsci build seven-segment-display.circuit.tsx --disable-parts-engine && tsci check shorts seven-segment-display.circuit.tsx
scripts.check:full:controller: npm run check:wiring:controller && tsci build controller.circuit.tsx --disable-parts-engine && tsci check shorts controller.circuit.tsx
scripts.export:gerbers:display: mkdir -p dist && tsci export seven-segment-display.circuit.tsx -f gerbers --disable-parts-engine -o dist/gerbers-display.zip
scripts.export:gerbers:controller: mkdir -p dist && tsci export controller.circuit.tsx -f gerbers --disable-parts-engine -o dist/gerbers-controller.zip
scripts.export:images:display: tsci build seven-segment-display.circuit.tsx --disable-parts-engine --pcb-png --3d-png && mkdir -p docs/images && cp dist/seven-segment-display/pcb.png docs/images/display-pcb.png && cp dist/seven-segment-display/3d.png docs/images/display-3d.png
scripts.export:images:controller: tsci build controller.circuit.tsx --disable-parts-engine --pcb-png --3d-png && mkdir -p docs/images && cp dist/controller/pcb.png docs/images/controller-pcb.png && cp dist/controller/3d.png docs/images/controller-3d.png
